title: Add pastel agent identities to CommandCenterUI
description: Show chat and presence participants with a concise display name plus inferred agent type, using stable muted-pastel identity chips. Preserve underlying sender names for mentions, routing, and reply behavior. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Chat and presence displays show a concise agent name plus an inferred type without changing sender IDs used for mentions or replies.
Each supported agent type has a readable muted-pastel identity treatment.
Live and installer code remains equivalent and focused checks pass.
